purpose: HMRC Hydrocarbon Oils Bulletin petrol and diesel quantities released for consumption by fiscal year; DESNZ annual average ULSP and ULSD pump prices; OBR fuel duty receipts by vehicle category; ONS mid-year UK population totals. Consumed by the LCFS donor litre-proxy uprating and the household-incidence fuel diagnostics.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
